summary: Implemented the speed indicator feature in rich/progress.py, CHANGELOG.md, and tests/test_progress.py. Changes: TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed option (default off), a classmethod render_speed(speed) that formats speed via filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix with base 1000 and " it/s" suffix (None gives empty text), and a render override that shows speed when the total is unknown and show_speed is on (using finished_speed or speed). The class docstring now has an Args section. The track() helper gained show_speed (default True), passed to the column, with a docstring entry. Progress.track now infers total from explicit value or Sized length, otherwise leaves it None without raising. CHANGELOG has a new Added line. Tests: removed the two ValueError assertions in test_track and test_progress_track, and added test_task_progress_column_speed. Nothing was run (no tests, mypy, or black) per instructions, and nothing was committed. Validation is therefore unverified.
